description: Source code for TrustStoreAndroid class managing Android trust store, including initialization, certificate parsing, trust retrieval, and observing certificate database changes.

classes.name: TrustStoreAndroid::Impl
classes.description: Implementation class managing the in-memory trust store, handling certificate parsing and trust queries, with thread-safe reference counting.

methods.name: TrustStoreAndroid::ObserveCertDBChanges
methods.description: Registers as observer for certificate database changes.

methods.name: TrustStoreAndroid::OnCertDBChanged
methods.description: Handles certificate database change events, updating trust store generation.

methods.name: TrustStoreAndroid::MaybeInitializeAndGetImpl
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the current trust store implementation.

methods.name: TrustStoreAndroid::SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate.

methods.name: TrustStoreAndroid::GetTrust
methods.description: Retrieves trust information for a given certificate.
